before_times: new or returning (a new student gets the level check first, and the waiver)
what to work on: first turns, stopping, a steeper run, or a snowboard
where: the ski school, at the lodge, or at a meeting spot on the mountain
a single lesson, a pack or a weekly plan
one person or two (a partner lesson)
after_time: gear: whether the student has skis or a board, or will rent one at the resort
the lodge and the door to meet at (lodge lessons)
the lift the student wants to meet at (mountain lessons)
an instructor they'd like, or either
secure_page_only: 18 or older (6 to 17 with a parent or guardian who books and signs)
the health questions: the standard check before exercise (heart, dizziness, back, knee or other joint injuries, medicines, a doctor's limits), and any injury now
the lodge address and room, or the meeting spot and lift
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone 6 to 17, who signs the waiver and meets the child at the meeting point; under 6 is not booked (the example's minimum, set by the owner)

stop.words: someone hurt on the hill right now: a fall with a hit to the head, not waking up, bleeding badly, or not breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the ski patrol. Rosie can help you book later.

stop.words: an avalanche, a whiteout, or someone lost in the snow right now
stop.say: Get to a safe place and call 911 or the ski patrol now. Rosie can help you book later.

stop.words: someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or sudden weakness
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can help you book later.

go_on.words: a heart condition, chest pain during exercise, dizziness, a past knee or back injury, pregnancy, or a recent surgery
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the instructor reads it before the lesson and may ask for a doctor's OK; Rosie gives no health advice
not an instructor's work: Rosie says ski instructors don't treat injuries, and the AI can look for a licensed physical therapist

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Free level check
steps.when: booked first, at least the day before the first lesson
steps.result: OK to ski or ride; a change (another length or a plan); or a doctor's OK first, when the lesson moves or is cancelled with a full refund

steps.name: Health questions
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; asked again every 12 months, or when something changes
steps.result: all no: it books; a yes: the instructor reads it privately before the lesson, and may ask for a doctor's OK

steps.name: Waiver
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking, before the first lesson
steps.who: every new student; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Doctor's OK
steps.when: only when the instructor asks, after a health answer or the level check
steps.result: a note from the student's doctor that skiing or riding is OK, added on the secure page; the booking waits for it

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: warm layers, gloves, goggles or sunglasses, and water; skis or a board, or the rental the student books; at a lodge, a clear spot by the door

staff.skills: first turns, stopping, steeper runs, snowboard basics, and kids; kids only with instructors the owner clears for them
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license is checked for ski lessons; an instructor's certificate and first-aid card are the business's own word
staff.supervision: an instructor in training works only with a lead instructor there
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs same-day lessons, every fee and every used-up pack lesson; he can also set each first visit to a new student's lodge or meeting spot to ask him first (off in this example); the instructor reads health answers and may ask for a doctor's OK
staff.stand_in: another instructor with the same skill can cover, if the student says yes; or new times, or a free cancel

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone 6 to 17, who signs the waiver and meets the child at the meeting point; under 6 is not booked (the example's minimum, set by the owner)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's booking texts go to the parent or guardian who booked

visit.check_in: at the ski school: the check-in code at the meeting point desk; at a lodge: the code at the door; at a meeting spot: the code at the spot; a video or phone check-in: read out at the start
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the instructor; a lesson from a pack counts down by one
visit.changes_at_visit: an add-on (a warm-up extra) is priced and OK'd first; more lessons or a pack only if the student asks

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: ski and snowboard lessons need no state license here; a license or insurance is optional and the business's own word (D96)
license.who: the business, for any registration, certificate or insurance it chooses to show
license.ask: optional: a registration or certificate number the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each instructor
license.insurance: liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; a resort or a school may ask to see it, and the business shows it there
license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: health answers, injuries, a doctor's note and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the student's record
